meta.title: CJ (Jignesh Nishad) — Video Editor & Motion Designer
meta.description: Freelance video editor and motion designer with 100+ projects completed. Editing long-form YouTube videos, documentaries, and motion graphics using Premiere Pro and After Effects.

hero.headline: Video editor & motion designer.
hero.subline: Hey, I'm CJ (Jignesh). I edit long-form YouTube videos, documentaries, and create motion graphics using Premiere Pro and After Effects.

services.title: Long-Form & Documentary Editing
services.audience: For YouTube creators, independent documentaries, and storytelling channels
includes: Complete story assembly and timeline pacing
A-roll dialogue cleanup and multi-camera syncing
B-roll cutaways and archival footage integration
Background music selection and balanced audio mix

services.title: Motion Graphics & Title Design
services.audience: For channels, founders, and videos that need visual clarity and kinetic energy
includes: Custom kinetic typography and animated subtitles
Intro sequences, lower thirds, and chapter title cards
Animated maps, charts, and technical callouts

services.title: UI Animation & Resource Embedding
services.audience: For product demos, software explainers, and videos featuring digital interfaces
includes: Extracting provided UI components and design resources from Figma
Prepping logos, icons, and vector files from Adobe Illustrator
Embedding assets cleanly into After Effects and Premiere Pro timelines
Animating smooth screen interactions, cursor paths, and transitions

process.label: Footage & Direction
process.description: Upload your raw footage, audio recordings, and any reference videos to Google Drive or Dropbox. We talk through your goals, style, and timeline.

process.label: The Story Cut
process.description: I organize the footage, assemble the core storyline, and tighten the pacing in Premiere Pro. You get a private link to review the structure and narrative flow.

process.label: Motion, Sound & Color
process.description: Once the story is locked, I build custom motion graphics and titles in After Effects, clean up the dialogue, mix sound effects, and color grade the cut.

process.label: Review & Delivery
process.description: We review the cut together, make any requested adjustments, and I export full-resolution masters ready to publish, along with any project files.
